name: OWASP ZAP
description: OWASP ZAP automation: spider and active scan job control, alerts, context/scope management, and core session/site/URL operations

document.name: Start Spider Scan
document.description: Starts crawling the target site with the Spider tool, optionally against a specific context.

a1a1.name: spiderActionScan
a1a1.description: Starts crawling the target site with the Spider tool, optionally against a specific context.

document.name: Get Spider Scan Status
document.description: Returns the percentage complete for a spider scan, or for all spider scans if scanId is omitted.

a1a1.name: spiderViewStatus
a1a1.description: Returns the percentage complete for a spider scan, or for all spider scans if scanId is omitted.

document.name: Stop Spider Scan
document.description: Stops a running spider scan, or all spider scans if scanId is omitted.

a1a1.name: spiderActionStop
a1a1.description: Stops a running spider scan, or all spider scans if scanId is omitted.

document.name: Get Spider Scan Results
document.description: Returns the URLs discovered by a spider scan.

a1a1.name: spiderViewResults
a1a1.description: Returns the URLs discovered by a spider scan.

document.name: List Spider Scans
document.description: Returns all spider scans, including running, finished, and stopped ones.

a1a1.name: spiderViewScans
a1a1.description: Returns all spider scans, including running, finished, and stopped ones.

document.name: Remove Spider Scan
document.description: Removes a spider scan (it must not be running).

a1a1.name: spiderActionRemoveScan
a1a1.description: Removes a spider scan (it must not be running).

document.name: Start Active Scan
document.description: Starts an Active Scan against the target, optionally through a defined Scan Policy.

a1a1.name: ascanActionScan
a1a1.description: Starts an Active Scan against the target, optionally through a defined Scan Policy.

document.name: Get Active Scan Status
document.description: Returns the percentage complete for an active scan, or for all active scans if scanId is omitted.

a1a1.name: ascanViewStatus
a1a1.description: Returns the percentage complete for an active scan, or for all active scans if scanId is omitted.

document.name: Stop Active Scan
document.description: Stops a running active scan.

a1a1.name: ascanActionStop
a1a1.description: Stops a running active scan.

document.name: Pause Active Scan
document.description: Pauses a running active scan.

a1a1.name: ascanActionPause
a1a1.description: Pauses a running active scan.

document.name: Resume Active Scan
document.description: Resumes a paused active scan.

a1a1.name: ascanActionResume
a1a1.description: Resumes a paused active scan.

document.name: Remove Active Scan
document.description: Removes an active scan (it must not be running).

a1a1.name: ascanActionRemoveScan
a1a1.description: Removes an active scan (it must not be running).

document.name: List Active Scans
document.description: Returns all active scans, including running, finished, and stopped ones.

a1a1.name: ascanViewScans
a1a1.description: Returns all active scans, including running, finished, and stopped ones.

document.name: Get Active Scan Alert IDs
document.description: Returns the IDs of the alerts raised while an active scan ran.

a1a1.name: ascanViewAlertsIds
a1a1.description: Returns the IDs of the alerts raised while an active scan ran.

document.name: List Alerts
document.description: Returns the alerts raised, optionally filtered by base URL, risk level, or context.

a1a1.name: alertViewAlerts
a1a1.description: Returns the alerts raised, optionally filtered by base URL, risk level, or context.

document.name: Get Alert
document.description: Returns full details for a single alert.

a1a1.name: alertViewAlert
a1a1.description: Returns full details for a single alert.

document.name: Get Alerts Summary
document.description: Returns a count of alerts grouped by risk level, optionally filtered by base URL.

a1a1.name: alertViewAlertsSummary
a1a1.description: Returns a count of alerts grouped by risk level, optionally filtered by base URL.

document.name: Get Number Of Alerts
document.description: Returns the number of alerts, optionally filtered by base URL and risk level.

a1a1.name: alertViewNumberOfAlerts
a1a1.description: Returns the number of alerts, optionally filtered by base URL and risk level.

document.name: Delete Alert
document.description: Deletes a single alert.

a1a1.name: alertActionDeleteAlert
a1a1.description: Deletes a single alert.

document.name: Delete All Alerts
document.description: Deletes every alert raised in the current session.

a1a1.name: alertActionDeleteAllAlerts
a1a1.description: Deletes every alert raised in the current session.

document.name: Create Context
document.description: Creates a new context.

a1a1.name: contextActionNewContext
a1a1.description: Creates a new context.

document.name: List Contexts
document.description: Returns the names of all configured contexts.

a1a1.name: contextViewContextList
a1a1.description: Returns the names of all configured contexts.

document.name: Get Context
document.description: Returns the full details of a single context.

a1a1.name: contextViewContext
a1a1.description: Returns the full details of a single context.

document.name: Remove Context
document.description: Removes a context.

a1a1.name: contextActionRemoveContext
a1a1.description: Removes a context.

document.name: Include In Context
document.description: Adds a regex pattern of URLs to include in a context's scope.

a1a1.name: contextActionIncludeInContext
a1a1.description: Adds a regex pattern of URLs to include in a context's scope.

document.name: Exclude From Context
document.description: Adds a regex pattern of URLs to exclude from a context's scope.

a1a1.name: contextActionExcludeFromContext
a1a1.description: Adds a regex pattern of URLs to exclude from a context's scope.

document.name: Get Context URLs
document.description: Returns the URLs accessed through/within a context.

a1a1.name: contextViewUrls
a1a1.description: Returns the URLs accessed through/within a context.

document.name: List Sites
document.description: Returns every site (top-level host) currently known to the session.

a1a1.name: coreViewSites
a1a1.description: Returns every site (top-level host) currently known to the session.

document.name: Get URLs
document.description: Returns every URL accessed, optionally filtered by base URL.

a1a1.name: coreViewUrls
a1a1.description: Returns every URL accessed, optionally filtered by base URL.

document.name: Get Version
document.description: Returns the running ZAP version.

a1a1.name: coreViewVersion
a1a1.description: Returns the running ZAP version.

document.name: Access URL
document.description: Makes ZAP load a URL through the proxy, adding it to the session so it can be spidered/scanned.

a1a1.name: coreActionAccessUrl
a1a1.description: Makes ZAP load a URL through the proxy, adding it to the session so it can be spidered/scanned.

document.name: New Session
document.description: Creates a new session, discarding in-memory data not yet saved.

a1a1.name: coreActionNewSession
a1a1.description: Creates a new session, discarding in-memory data not yet saved.

document.name: Save Session
document.description: Saves the current session to disk.

a1a1.name: coreActionSaveSession
a1a1.description: Saves the current session to disk.
